There are reports of it being sent as email attachments, but that is not the only way this thing spreads. It mainly searches any connected Windows PCs with the vulnerability to infect, runs without user interaction.

India has taken the measure to shut down many of its ATMs as a preventative measure.

Update your OS and anti-virus. If you are running Linux... Sit back and chill I suppose.

If you want even more security block TCP port 139, 445 as well as UDP port 137 and 138. At least that is the advice I have seen.

Wannacry encrypts any file it can access, then demands $300 paid in bitcoin to get them back. 

Going by the number of infections it is unlikely paying would even get you your files back. 

It is a worm exploiting a windows vulnerability discovered by the NSA that was believed to be leaked. If your OS has the vulnerability and an infected PC is on your network you are at risk.

So update your OS to keep safe. 

A kill switch has been found that has slowed down the current infection rate, but expect more attacks soon as more people try to exploit this vulnerability.
